evaluationSuite.purpose: Independent AI-authored unseen comparison; final reviewer acceptance after author revision; shared filesystem, no OS isolation

incompleteCases.question: 对2018年1月1日含至4月1日不含创建的工单，按工单分类ID及名称统计工单数和已解决工单平均处理小时数（2位小数）。输出分类ID、名称、工单数、平均小时，分类ID升序NULL最后；分类缺失保留未知组，解决时间为空者只不参与平均，不筛status。
对2018年开始的各营销活动，统计活动商品在该活动开始日至结束日（两端含整日）内下单的有效订单商品行数和商品金额（不含运费）。只输出有匹配商品行的活动ID、名称、商品行数、金额，活动ID升序；有效订单排除取消和不可用，同一商品属于多个活动时各活动独立计入。
按仓库所在地大区统计2018年3月至5月发货的运输记录数，仅计其订单自然人当前属于正常会员（status=1），且该会员存在CHURN_RISK标签的记录。只输出大区、运输记录数，大区升序NULL最后；沿订单customer_id定位自然人，重复标签或多客户档案不得放大运输记录，仓库地域未知保留NULL组，订单状态不限。
对2018年第二季度核销、订单也在同一季度下单的用券有效订单，按券所属活动和用券记录会员的当前等级汇总核销优惠金额与不同订单数。只计券、活动、会员、等级都匹配的核销记录，输出活动ID、活动名称、等级ID、等级名称、优惠金额、订单数，活动ID和等级ID升序；有效订单排除取消与不可用，不用订单买家的会员替换核销记录member_id。
对2018年8月有点击的搜索日志，按搜索会员当前等级及点击商品当前品牌统计日志条数。只计能匹配会员、等级和商品的日志；无当前品牌保留NULL品牌，商品多当前品牌时分别计数。输出等级ID、等级名称、品牌ID、品牌名称、日志条数，等级ID、品牌ID升序NULL最后；未知会员日志排除，不按会员去重。
统计2018年上半年创建的推荐，按推荐人当前等级分组，只计被推荐人当前有HIGH_VALUE标签且两端会员及推荐人等级都真实存在的记录。输出等级ID、等级名称、推荐条数、已转化条数和奖励总额，等级ID升序；奖励取全部入选推荐原始reward_amount，NULL忽略，未转化记录不删除，不按被推荐人人数去重。
对2018年7月下单的有效订单，按买家当前会员等级和商品英文类目汇总商品行数与含运费金额。只计买家能通过订单customer_id定位自然人并匹配当前会员、等级的订单明细；商品必须存在，无翻译或原始类目未知保留NULL英文组。输出等级ID、等级名称、英文类目、商品行数、含运费金额，等级ID及英文类目升序NULL最后；有效订单排除取消和不可用。
按卖家所在地大区计算2018年上半年有效订单商品行的运费占GMV比例，GMV含运费。只输出大区和运费占比，0至100百分数2位，大区升序NULL最后。大区未知保留，分母是同组商品金额加运费合计，分子是同组运费合计，分母为0或未知返回NULL；有效订单排除取消和不可用。

itemEvidence.finalSql: SELECT order_id, order_status, order_approved_at FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_carrier_date IS NULL ORDER BY order_approved_at, order_id LIMIT 30;

SELECT product_id, product_weight_g, product_length_cm, product_height_cm, product_width_cm FROM products WHERE product_length_cm >= 40 AND product_height_cm >= 40 AND product_width_cm >= 40 AND product_weight_g IS NOT NULL ORDER BY product_weight_g DESC, product_id LIMIT 25;
SELECT member_id, customer_unique_id, points FROM members WHERE status=2 AND points>=1500 ORDER BY points DESC,member_id LIMIT 40;
SELECT coupon_id,coupon_code,discount_value,min_order_amount FROM coupons WHERE discount_type='fixed' AND min_order_amount BETWEEN 100 AND 300 ORDER BY min_order_amount,coupon_id LIMIT 35;
SELECT shipment_id,order_id,carrier,shipped_at FROM shipments WHERE status=2 AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL ORDER BY shipped_at,shipment_id LIMIT 40;
SELECT refund_id,order_id,refund_amount,reason_code FROM refunds WHERE status=2 AND refund_amount>150 ORDER BY refund_amount DESC,refund_id LIMIT 30;
SELECT ticket_id,order_id,created_at FROM support_tickets WHERE priority=4 AND resolved_at IS NULL AND created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at,ticket_id LIMIT 30;

SELECT log_id,keyword,clicked_product_id,searched_at FROM search_logs WHERE result_count=0 AND clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL AND searched_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY searched_at DESC,log_id DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,safety_stock-quantity AS shortage FROM inventory WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL AND safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND quantity<safety_stock ORDER BY shortage DESC,warehouse_id,product_id LIMIT 40;

SELECT history_id,product_id,old_price-new_price AS decrease_amount FROM product_price_history WHERE old_price IS NOT NULL AND new_price IS NOT NULL AND old_price-new_price>=50 ORDER BY decrease_amount DESC,history_id LIMIT 30;

SELECT review_id,order_id,review_creation_date FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score=3 AND review_comment_message IS NULL AND review_creation_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY review_creation_date DESC,review_id,order_id LIMIT 20;

SELECT order_id,payment_sequential,payment_installments,payment_value FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type='credit_card' AND payment_installments>=8 AND payment_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY payment_value DESC,order_id,payment_sequential LIMIT 25;
SELECT settlement_id,seller_id,period_start,net_amount FROM settlements WHERE status=2 AND net_amount>1000 ORDER BY net_amount DESC,settlement_id LIMIT 30;
SELECT address_id,customer_id,city FROM shipping_addresses WHERE is_default IS TRUE AND state='RJ' AND city IS NOT NULL ORDER BY city,address_id LIMIT 40;

SELECT referral_id,referrer_member_id,invitee_member_id,reward_amount FROM referrals WHERE referrer_member_id IS NOT NULL AND invitee_member_id IS NOT NULL AND converted_at IS NULL AND reward_amount>0 AND created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at,referral_id LIMIT 20;
SELECT campaign_id,campaign_name,campaign_type,budget FROM campaigns WHERE status=3 AND budget>0 ORDER BY budget,campaign_id LIMIT 12;
SELECT brand_id,brand_name FROM brands WHERE country='BR' ORDER BY brand_name NULLS LAST,brand_id LIMIT 25;

SELECT DISTINCT geolocation_zip_code_prefix FROM geolocation WHERE geolocation_state='SC' AND geolocation_lat IS NOT NULL AND geolocation_lng IS NOT NULL AND geolocation_zip_code_prefix IS NOT NULL ORDER BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix LIMIT 40;
SELECT message_id,ticket_id,created_at FROM ticket_messages WHERE sender_type='customer' AND content IS NOT NULL AND created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC,message_id DESC LIMIT 35;
SELECT warehouse_id,warehouse_name,region_code,capacity FROM warehouses WHERE capacity>0 ORDER BY capacity,warehouse_id LIMIT 8;

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS profile_count, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS people_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY profile_count DESC, customer_state NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products GROUP BY product_category_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 80 ORDER BY product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(payment_value) AS paid_amount, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_paid_amount FROM order_payments WHERE payment_installments = 1 GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT seller_id,COUNT(*) AS item_rows,SUM(price) AS product_amount FROM order_items WHERE seller_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY item_rows DESC,seller_id LIMIT 18;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS member_count, COUNT(points) AS known_points_count, ROUND(AVG(points), 2) AS avg_points FROM members GROUP BY status ORDER BY status NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT keyword,COUNT(*) AS zero_result_searches FROM search_logs WHERE result_count=0 AND keyword IS NOT NULL GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY zero_result_searches DESC,keyword LIMIT 22;

SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS timed_count FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY carrier NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY reason_code NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NULL) AS unresolved_count FROM support_tickets GROUP BY priority ORDER BY priority NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS product_slots, SUM(quantity) AS quantity_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity < safety_stock) AS below_safety_slots FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id LIMIT 201
SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS movement_count, SUM(quantity) AS quantity_total FROM inventory_movements GROUP BY movement_type ORDER BY movement_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT member_id,COUNT(*) AS usage_count,SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_total FROM coupon_usages WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY member_id HAVING SUM(discount_amount)>0 ORDER BY discount_total DESC,member_id LIMIT 20;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS settlement_count, SUM(net_amount) AS net_total, ROUND(AVG(net_amount), 2) AS avg_net FROM settlements GROUP BY status ORDER BY status NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT CASE WHEN new_price > old_price THEN '上涨' WHEN new_price < old_price THEN '下跌' ELSE '持平' END AS direction, COUNT(*) AS change_count FROM product_price_history WHERE old_price IS NOT NULL AND new_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY direction LIMIT 201

SELECT CASE WHEN reward_amount IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN reward_amount <= 0 THEN '非正' WHEN reward_amount <= 10 THEN '0到10' WHEN reward_amount <= 20 THEN '10到20' ELSE '超过20' END AS reward_bucket, COUNT(*) AS referral_count, COUNT(converted_at) AS converted_count, SUM(reward_amount) AS reward_total FROM referrals GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY reward_bucket LIMIT 201

SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_comment_message IS NULL) AS null_body_count FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS campaign_count, ROUND(AVG(budget), 2) AS avg_budget FROM campaigns WHERE budget > 0 GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY campaign_type NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_default IS TRUE) AS default_count, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_key_count FROM shipping_addresses GROUP BY state ORDER BY state NULLS LAST LIMIT 201
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS brand_count FROM brands GROUP BY country ORDER BY brand_count DESC, country NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(order_approved_at) AS approved_time_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-09-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) LIMIT 201

WITH m AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND ((order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01') OR (order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01')) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT LPAD(a.mo::text, 2, '0') AS month, a.n AS orders_2018, b.n AS orders_2017, a.n - b.n AS order_delta FROM m a JOIN m b ON b.mo = a.mo AND b.yr = 2017 WHERE a.yr = 2018 ORDER BY a.mo LIMIT 201

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM searched_at)::int AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS search_count, COUNT(clicked_product_id) AS clicked_count FROM search_logs WHERE searched_at >= '2018-05-10' AND searched_at < '2018-05-17' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', completed_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 4 AND completed_at >= '2018-04-01' AND completed_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', completed_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', completed_at) LIMIT 201

WITH ranked AS (SELECT h.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY changed_at DESC,history_id DESC) AS rn FROM product_price_history h WHERE changed_at<'2018-07-01' AND product_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT product_id,history_id,changed_at,new_price-old_price AS increase_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND new_price IS NOT NULL AND old_price IS NOT NULL AND new_price>old_price ORDER BY increase_amount DESC,product_id LIMIT 30;

WITH s AS (SELECT x.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,snapshot_id DESC) AS rn FROM member_snapshot x WHERE snapshot_date<='2018-06-30' AND member_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT member_id,snapshot_date,level_id,points FROM s WHERE rn=1 AND points BETWEEN 2000 AND 4000 ORDER BY member_id LIMIT 40;

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', moved_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(quantity) AS outbound_quantity, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inventory_movements WHERE movement_type = 2 AND moved_at >= '2018-03-01' AND moved_at < '2018-06-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', moved_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', moved_at) LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0), 2) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE created_at >= '2018-04-01' AND created_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) LIMIT 201

SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date FROM campaigns WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= end_date AND start_date < DATE '2018-07-01' AND end_date >= DATE '2018-06-01' ORDER BY start_date, campaign_id LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS settlement_count, SUM(net_amount) AS net_total FROM settlements WHERE paid_at >= '2018-01-01' AND paid_at < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_at) LIMIT 201

SELECT member_id,register_date,last_login_date FROM members WHERE register_date>='2018-01-01' AND register_date<'2018-04-01' AND last_login_date>='2018-07-01' ORDER BY register_date,member_id LIMIT 35;

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS referral_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted_at >= created_at AND converted_at <= created_at + INTERVAL '7 days') AS converted_within_7d FROM referrals WHERE created_at >= '2018-02-01' AND created_at < '2018-05-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(shipping_limit_date::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS deadline_date, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(price) AS product_amount FROM order_items WHERE shipping_limit_date >= '2018-08-20' AND shipping_limit_date < '2018-08-27' GROUP BY shipping_limit_date::date ORDER BY shipping_limit_date::date LIMIT 201

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', shipped_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_shipments, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE shipped_at >= '2018-06-01' AND shipped_at < '2018-08-01' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', shipped_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', shipped_at) LIMIT 201

WITH r AS (SELECT x.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY review_creation_date DESC,review_id DESC,order_id DESC) AS rn FROM order_reviews x WHERE review_creation_date>='2018-05-01' AND review_creation_date<'2018-06-01') SELECT order_id,review_id,review_creation_date FROM r WHERE rn=1 AND review_score=1 ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 30;

WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT TO_CHAR(a.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, a.n - b.n AS order_delta FROM m a JOIN m b ON b.month = a.month - INTERVAL '1 month' ORDER BY a.month LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01' GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY r.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(oi.price) AS product_amount FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY r.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT t.product_category_name_english,SUM(i.quantity) AS stock_quantity FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english HAVING SUM(i.quantity)>0 ORDER BY stock_quantity DESC,t.product_category_name_english NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

SELECT l.level_id, l.level_name, COUNT(m.member_id) AS frozen_members FROM member_levels l LEFT JOIN members m ON m.level_id = l.level_id AND m.status = 2 GROUP BY l.level_id, l.level_name ORDER BY l.level_id LIMIT 201

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, COUNT(cp.coupon_id) AS fixed_coupon_count FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN coupons cp ON cp.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND cp.discount_type = 'fixed' WHERE c.status = 3 GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name ORDER BY c.campaign_id LIMIT 201

SELECT c.campaign_id,c.campaign_name,SUM(u.discount_amount) AS discount_total,COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM coupon_usages u JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id=u.coupon_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id=cp.campaign_id WHERE u.used_at>='2018-03-01' AND u.used_at<'2018-06-01' GROUP BY c.campaign_id,c.campaign_name HAVING SUM(u.discount_amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY discount_total DESC,c.campaign_id LIMIT 12;

SELECT p.product_category_name,SUM(ri.refund_qty) AS refund_units,SUM(ri.refund_value) AS refund_value FROM refund_items ri JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id=ri.order_item_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING SUM(ri.refund_qty) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY refund_units DESC,p.product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 18;

SELECT r.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS shipped_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivered_at IS NULL) AS unsigned_records FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_tracking tr WHERE tr.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND tr.location IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY r.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT tc.category_id, tc.category_name, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0), 2) AS avg_hours FROM support_tickets st LEFT JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id WHERE st.created_at >= '2018-01-01' AND st.created_at < '2018-04-01' GROUP BY tc.category_id, tc.category_name ORDER BY tc.category_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT st.ticket_id,st.order_id,COUNT(tm.message_id) AS customer_message_count FROM support_tickets st LEFT JOIN ticket_messages tm ON tm.ticket_id=st.ticket_id AND tm.sender_type='customer' WHERE st.priority=4 GROUP BY st.ticket_id,st.order_id ORDER BY customer_message_count DESC,st.ticket_id LIMIT 25;

SELECT b.brand_id, b.brand_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS current_product_count FROM brands b LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pb ON pb.brand_id = b.brand_id AND pb.is_current IS TRUE LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pb.product_id GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name ORDER BY b.brand_id LIMIT 201

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS change_count, ROUND(AVG(h.new_price - h.old_price), 2) AS avg_price_delta FROM product_price_history h JOIN products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND h.changed_at >= '2018-04-01' AND h.changed_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY p.product_category_name LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipping_addresses a WHERE a.customer_id = o.customer_id AND a.is_default IS TRUE AND a.state = c.customer_state) GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state LIMIT 201

SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_code, t.tag_name, COUNT(m.member_id) AS normal_member_count FROM user_tags t LEFT JOIN user_tag_map tm ON tm.tag_id = t.tag_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = tm.member_id AND m.status = 1 GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_code, t.tag_name ORDER BY t.tag_id LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_id, l.level_name, COUNT(*) AS referral_count, COUNT(r.converted_at) AS converted_count FROM referrals r JOIN members m ON m.member_id = r.referrer_member_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id GROUP BY l.level_id, l.level_name ORDER BY l.level_id LIMIT 201

SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(st.net_amount) AS net_total, COUNT(*) AS settlement_count FROM settlements st LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = st.seller_id WHERE st.status = 3 AND st.period_start >= '2018-03-01' AND st.period_start < '2018-06-01' GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY s.seller_state NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT p.product_category_name,SUM(si.gross_amount) AS gross_total,SUM(si.commission_amount) AS commission_total FROM settlement_items si JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=si.order_id AND oi.order_item_id=si.order_item_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING SUM(si.gross_amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gross_total DESC,p.product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 16;

SELECT t.product_category_name_english,COUNT(*) AS clicked_searches FROM search_logs sl LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id=sl.clicked_product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name WHERE sl.clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL AND sl.searched_at>='2018-07-01' AND sl.searched_at<'2018-08-01' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY clicked_searches DESC,t.product_category_name_english NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(im.quantity) AS returned_quantity, COUNT(*) AS movement_count FROM inventory_movements im JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = im.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = im.product_id WHERE w.region_code = 'SP' AND im.movement_type = 3 AND im.moved_at >= '2018-08-01' AND im.moved_at < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY p.product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(op.payment_value) AS paid_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments op JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = op.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE op.payment_type = 'debit_card' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH x AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.order_id, r.review_score, p.product_category_name FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL) SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score <= 2) AS low_score_count FROM x GROUP BY product_category_name ORDER BY product_category_name LIMIT 201

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(oi.price) AS product_amount FROM campaigns c JOIN campaign_products cp ON cp.campaign_id = c.campaign_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = cp.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE c.start_date >= '2018-01-01' AND c.start_date < '2019-01-01' AND c.end_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= c.start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < c.end_date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name ORDER BY c.campaign_id LIMIT 201

SELECT b.brand_id, b.brand_name, rg.macro_region, SUM(ri.refund_qty) AS refund_units, SUM(ri.refund_value) AS refund_value FROM refunds r JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id AND ri.order_id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pb ON pb.product_id = p.product_id AND pb.is_current IS TRUE LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pb.brand_id LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_code = s.seller_state WHERE r.status = 4 AND r.requested_at >= '2018-01-01' AND r.requested_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name, rg.macro_region ORDER BY b.brand_id NULLS LAST, rg.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT rg.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_code = w.region_code WHERE s.shipped_at >= '2018-03-01' AND s.shipped_at < '2018-06-01' AND m.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_tag_map ut JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = ut.tag_id WHERE ut.member_id = m.member_id AND t.tag_code = 'CHURN_RISK') GROUP BY rg.macro_region ORDER BY rg.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name, ml.level_id, ml.level_name, SUM(cu.discount_amount) AS discount_total, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.order_id) AS order_count FROM coupon_usages cu JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = cu.member_id JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id WHERE cu.used_at >= '2018-04-01' AND cu.used_at < '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name, ml.level_id, ml.level_name ORDER BY ca.campaign_id, ml.level_id LIMIT 201

SELECT rg.macro_region, t.product_category_name_english, SUM(si.gross_amount) AS gross_total, SUM(si.commission_amount) AS commission_total FROM settlement_items si JOIN settlements st ON st.settlement_id = si.settlement_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = st.seller_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = si.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = si.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_code = s.seller_state LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE st.period_start >= '2018-01-01' AND st.period_start < '2018-04-01' GROUP BY rg.macro_region, t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY rg.macro_region NULLS LAST, t.product_category_name_english NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH msg AS (SELECT ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ticket_messages WHERE sender_type = 'customer' GROUP BY ticket_id) SELECT rg.macro_region, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(COALESCE(msg.n, 0)) AS customer_message_count FROM support_tickets st JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_code = c.customer_state LEFT JOIN msg ON msg.ticket_id = st.ticket_id WHERE st.created_at >= '2018-06-01' AND st.created_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY rg.macro_region ORDER BY rg.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_id, l.level_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name, COUNT(*) AS clicked_logs FROM search_logs sl JOIN members m ON m.member_id = sl.member_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = sl.clicked_product_id LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pb ON pb.product_id = p.product_id AND pb.is_current IS TRUE LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pb.brand_id WHERE sl.clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL AND sl.searched_at >= '2018-08-01' AND sl.searched_at < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY l.level_id, l.level_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name ORDER BY l.level_id, b.brand_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH mv AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM inventory_movements WHERE movement_type=2 AND moved_at>='2018-09-01' AND moved_at<'2018-10-01' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT rg.macro_region,t.product_category_name_english,SUM(i.quantity) AS stock_qty,SUM(CASE WHEN mv.product_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mv.qty END) AS outbound_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_code=w.region_code LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name=p.product_category_name LEFT JOIN mv ON mv.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND mv.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY rg.macro_region,t.product_category_name_english HAVING SUM(i.quantity) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stock_qty DESC,rg.macro_region NULLS LAST,t.product_category_name_english NULLS LAST LIMIT 150;

WITH it AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS v FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), pay AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS v FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id), rf AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS v FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) SELECT rg.macro_region, SUM(CASE WHEN it.order_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.v END) AS product_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN pay.order_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE pay.v END) AS paid_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN rf.order_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE rf.v END) AS refund_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_code = c.customer_state LEFT JOIN it ON it.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN rf ON rf.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01' GROUP BY rg.macro_region ORDER BY rg.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_id, l.level_name, COUNT(*) AS referral_count, COUNT(r.converted_at) AS converted_count, SUM(r.reward_amount) AS reward_total FROM referrals r JOIN members src ON src.member_id = r.referrer_member_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = src.level_id JOIN members dst ON dst.member_id = r.invitee_member_id WHERE r.created_at >= '2018-01-01' AND r.created_at < '2018-07-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_tag_map ut JOIN user_tags t ON t.tag_id = ut.tag_id WHERE ut.member_id = dst.member_id AND t.tag_code = 'HIGH_VALUE') GROUP BY l.level_id, l.level_name ORDER BY l.level_id LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_id, l.level_name, t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS amount_with_freight FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01' GROUP BY l.level_id, l.level_name, t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY l.level_id, t.product_category_name_english NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH p AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL AND c.customer_state = 'MG' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-01' GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_pct FROM p LIMIT 201

WITH ot AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS gmv FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(ot.gmv) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN ot ON ot.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM members m WHERE m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS member_order_pct FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS on_time_pct FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 201

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.freight_value) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 0), 2) AS freight_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY r.macro_region ORDER BY r.macro_region NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

WITH u AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_total FROM coupon_usages GROUP BY order_id), it AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS gmv FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(u.discount_total) / NULLIF(SUM(it.gmv), 0), 2) AS discount_pct FROM orders o JOIN u ON u.order_id = o.order_id JOIN it ON it.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 201

WITH v AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS t FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL), f AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(t) AS first_t FROM v GROUP BY customer_unique_id), cohort AS (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM f WHERE first_t >= '2017-11-01' AND first_t < '2017-12-01'), returned AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_unique_id FROM v WHERE t >= '2018-01-01' AND t < '2018-02-01') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(returned.customer_unique_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS retention_pct FROM cohort LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.customer_unique_id = cohort.customer_unique_id LIMIT 201

WITH f AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS first_month FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id), it AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS gmv FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id), x AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, CASE WHEN c.customer_unique_id IS NULL OR f.first_month IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = f.first_month THEN 'NEW' WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) > f.first_month THEN 'RETURNING' ELSE NULL END AS cohort, CASE WHEN it.order_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE it.gmv END AS gmv FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN f ON f.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id LEFT JOIN it ON it.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01') SELECT TO_CHAR(MONTH, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, cohort, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(gmv) AS gmv FROM x GROUP BY MONTH, cohort ORDER BY MONTH, cohort NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT tc.category_id, tc.category_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600.0 <= tc.sla_hours) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS sla_pct FROM support_tickets st JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id WHERE st.created_at >= '2018-04-01' AND st.created_at < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY tc.category_id, tc.category_name ORDER BY tc.category_id LIMIT 201

SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(si.commission_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(si.gross_amount), 0), 4) AS commission_ratio FROM settlement_items si JOIN settlements st ON st.settlement_id = si.settlement_id LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = st.seller_id WHERE st.period_start >= '2018-05-01' AND st.period_start < '2018-08-01' GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY s.seller_state NULLS LAST LIMIT 201

SELECT l.level_id, l.level_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sl.clicked_product_id IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS click_pct FROM search_logs sl JOIN members m ON m.member_id = sl.member_id JOIN member_levels l ON l.level_id = m.level_id WHERE sl.searched_at >= '2018-09-01' AND sl.searched_at < '2018-10-01' GROUP BY l.level_id, l.level_name ORDER BY l.level_id LIMIT 201

WITH a AS (SELECT MAX(moved_at) AS t FROM inventory_movements), st AS (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id), mv AS (SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM inventory_movements CROSS JOIN a WHERE movement_type = 2 AND moved_at > a.t - INTERVAL '90 days' AND moved_at <= a.t GROUP BY warehouse_id) SELECT st.warehouse_id, ROUND(90.0 * st.qty / NULLIF(mv.qty, 0), 1) AS turnover_days FROM st LEFT JOIN mv ON mv.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id ORDER BY st.warehouse_id LIMIT 201
